en.title: European Accessibility Act One Year On: Companies Lag Behind Compliance
en.summary: One year after the European Accessibility Act took effect, many companies still lag in meeting compliance requirements. Meanwhile, Europe approved a bionic eye to restore vision, and Le Chene received Stevie Awards for inclusive workplace practices. In Taiwan, National Kaohsiung University received NT$2.4 million to improve barrier‑free facilities, while experts stress accessibility as an operational deadline rather than an IT project.

zh-TW.title: 歐洲無障礙法案一年 企業合規落後 無障礙進展多元
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲無障礙法案實施一年後，許多企業仍未達標。同時，歐洲批准義眼技術以恢復視力，Le Chene 榮獲 Stevie 獎肯定其包容職場。台灣國立高雄大學獲教育部 240 萬補助改善無障礙環境，並強調無障礙應為營運期限而非僅是 IT 專案。
